pages.text: Icy Expansion is the witch's answer to drowning. Rather than parting the sea with fire or force, it grows a hollow winter shell around the working, pushing liquid away and leaving a breathing chamber inside.$(br2)It is a sheltering rite, but never a gentle one.

In the live port this rite is worked from a $(bold)small ritual circle$(/) through a representative $(item)Frozen Heart$() trigger. It requires a $(bold)coven of at least two witches$(/) before the shell will begin to form. Stronger coven support makes the icy sphere grow larger.

pages.title: Underwater Refuge
pages.text: Once begun, the rite grows in pulses instead of appearing all at once. Water and other soft replaceable matter are pushed aside, the inside is cleared, and a hollow chamber is left behind. Cast it under the ocean, in flooded caverns, or anywhere you need a pocket of winter-made air long enough to work.
